# Draft:2025 San Juan warehouse shooting

Starting this draft not to work on it yet, but to remind myself that I believe it should be created and to invite additional contributors. See https://www.elvocero.com/ley-y-orden/se-cumple-un-a-o-de-la-masacre-en-empresa-de-plomer-a-en-r/article_66764ad9-ec37-4c71-b374-add2dd6759d4.html. This was not covered widely in the English-speaking world, but seems to meet Wikipedia:Notability guidelines for events based on coverage in Puerto Rico.
